name: JST XH 2-pin connector
description: Two-circuit 2.5mm-pitch wire-to-board connector; pin function follows the circuit it carries
requirements: Pins 1A and 1B are the two sides of circuit 1; pins 2A and 2B are the two sides of circuit 2
Connect the source to side A and the load to the matching side B
Keep current within the selected contact and wire rating
